Method of Attack: Ransomware infections infecting entire networks by hacking into public facing Remote Desktop servers over the Internet
Brute force attacks on Remote Desktop Protocol (RDP) services to gain unauthorized access
Use of exposed RDP services as a launching point for other attacks
Attack Vector: Exposed Remote Desktop Protocol (RDP) services connected directly to the Internet
Sale of hacked RDP accounts on criminal marketplaces such as xDedic
Indicators of Compromise: xDedic criminal marketplace selling hacked remote desktop services accounts
Shodan.io listings showing over 2 million computers running RDP connected directly to the Internet
Ransomware ransom demands ranging from $3,000 to $50,000 USD to decrypt infected systems
